ideas.title: Following the Money in Day-Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in day-care fraud cases, including the Minnesota investigation.
questions: How are scammers laundering money in day-care fraud cases?
What are the most common methods used to commit day-care fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money trail in day-care fraud cases can lead to the identification of key players and patterns, and I recommend using financial analysis to track the flow of money.
